sections.heading: Why dog hanbok is a strong search-intent page
paragraphs: A dog hanbok search is more specific than a broad pet outfit search. People looking for hanbok usually already know the cultural direction they want and need a faster way to compare color, ribbon placement, skirt balance, sleeve shape, and ceremonial mood.

That kind of search intent is closer to action. The user is often preparing for a holiday, studio shoot, themed event, social post, or gift idea and wants a stronger preview before spending money or time.

sections.heading: What makes hanbok references useful for AI pet fitting
paragraphs: Hanbok references work well when the outfit image clearly shows the jeogori shape, sleeve line, ribbon detail, and the overall volume of the lower half of the garment. These visible signals help the model keep the identity of the dog while preserving the traditional silhouette.

Compared with generic costumes, hanbok tends to have stronger visual structure. That makes it easier to compare whether the final preview still feels balanced, elegant, and recognizable as a Korean traditional outfit.

sections.heading: How to get a better dog hanbok preview
paragraphs: Use a dog photo with a readable face, stable front or near-front angle, and balanced lighting. Then pair it with a hanbok image where the neckline, ribbon, sleeve cut, and lower-body silhouette are visible without heavy clutter.

After generation, compare whether the result still reads as hanbok at a glance. If the image feels too generic, the usual fix is a stronger outfit reference rather than repeating the same request blindly.

faq.question: What photo works best for a dog hanbok preview?
faq.answer: A clear dog photo with a visible face and stable pose usually works best. Near-front images make identity preservation easier for the fitting model.

faq.question: Will the preview match a real hanbok exactly?
faq.answer: No. It is a visual planning aid. The result is useful for mood, silhouette, and design comparison before real-world purchase or fitting.
